title: Logging Expansion & Moderation Removal Update
summary: The HelpDesk bot now removes moderation/punishment controls and expands logging across commands and ticket lifecycle events.
added: Every slash command now posts a Slash Command Activity log to the configured log channel.
Commands used inside ticket channels also post a Ticket Command Activity record inside that ticket.
Ticket creation is now logged with channel, customer ID, and ticket category details.
Ticket deletion is now logged with channel ID, customer ID, category, and delete reason.
changed: Existing claim, unclaim, close, and ticket controls remain protected by the latest guards.
Support instructions keep the corrected Grey R. mention: <@1263248306264608871>.
Ticket and command logging is defensive so logging failures do not block the command itself.
removed: Removed ticket punishment/moderation controls from `/ticket admin`.
Removed the standalone moderation/revoke command from slash command sync.
Blocked any remaining moderation command paths at runtime.
